title: 司马光
pages_note: Read off the 目录 (教材 PDF index 12) and confirmed on each rendered page: 第七课 runs pp. 71–81, 第八课 starts p. 82. The 课文 is pp. 71–72 with the 生字 under its last lines on p. 72; 词语, 专有名词 and 句子 are on p. 73. 课堂练习 is pp. 74–78 (描一描写一写 74, 读一读/用一用 75, 扩展与替换/想一想说一说 76, 对话 77, 课堂游戏 78); the 阅读 text is pp. 79–81 with its 想一想 and 日积月累 on p. 81.

课文.text_note: Fully pinyin-annotated in the book. Not reproduced, by the same decision as L05: docs/chinese.md § 8 holds every 课文 back until the owner says where it may live.

生字.gloss_note: character and 拼音 are the book's; the gloss is authored here in both languages and is not printed in the book. The thirteen characters are printed in two rows (eight, then five) under the end of the 课文 on p. 72, with 耳 → 聪 and 衣 → 装 below them.

gloss.en: as in 司马, a two-character family name

专有名词.section_note: As in L03: the book prints 专有名词 (Proper nouns) between 词语 and 句子 on p. 73, with the pinyin capitalised as a name. Kept as the book has it; the lesson page may ignore it.

句子.py: shuǐ gāng pò le, shuǐ liú le chu lai.

where.zh: 课本第76页 扩展与替换

句型.pattern_note: The book prints no name for the pattern. It is read off the page: the ladder grows from 流 to 流了出来, and in the 替换 table 出来 is the one part printed in red and never swapped, while every swapped second half ends in 了 (水流了, 酒流了, 老师从教室里走了, 妈妈从家里跑了).
句型.substitutions_note: The blue 替换 table under the ladder on p. 76: 水缸破了， and 水流了 are underlined and swapped row by row; 出来。 is printed in red and stays. Added as the book prints it, as in L03 and L04.

读一读.page_break_note: all nine rows are on p. 75, above 用一用

用一用.rows_note: The book's own curly quotation marks around 扑通 are kept.

阅读.text_note: same copyright hold as the 课文. The margin of p. 79 prints ★ before each entry; 采摘 carries two example phrases under it rather than a gloss, kept here in brackets. p. 81 ends with the reading's 想一想，说一说 (four questions) and 日积月累 (勇气是智慧和一定程度教养的必然结果。——［俄国］列夫·托尔斯泰), neither reproduced.
